biotools.summary: AlignAIR is a deep learning-based tool for sequence alignment of immunoglobulin (Ig) sequences, designed to improve allele assignment accuracy and sequence segmentation compared to traditional methods. It offers a user-friendly web interface and container image for efficient processing of large datasets.
